summary: This tutorial explains how to perform peer review and collaborative editing in LibreOffice Writer. It starts by opening an existing document and enabling document tracking to record changes. Users can add comments, accept or reject edits, and include them in the final file. The tutorial demonstrates this using LibreOffice version 3.3.4 on Linux. It shows how to mark up text, insert comments, and delete text within a document. The document highlights edited text in different colors for easy identification. The tutorial also covers viewing previous edits made by collaborators, such as those from the GNU Social project. Overall, it provides a comprehensive guide to collaborative document editing in LibreOffice.
